executive_summary: Maven compilation failed due to a method signature mismatch in TaskManagementController. The controller is calling getUserTasks() with a Pageable parameter, but the TaskService interface expects two int parameters (page and size). This is a straightforward method signature incompatibility that requires updating either the service interface or the controller call.

errors.message: Method getUserTasks cannot be applied: required (Long,int,int), found (Long,Pageable)
errors.root_cause: The TaskManagementController is calling taskService.getUserTasks() with parameters (userId, Pageable), but the TaskService interface defines getUserTasks(Long userId, int page, int size). The method signature mismatch occurs because the controller is passing a Spring Pageable object instead of separate int parameters for page and size.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update the TaskService interface method signature to accept Pageable: change 'Page<TaskDTO> getUserTasks(Long userId, int page, int size)' to 'Page<TaskDTO> getUserTasks(Long userId, Pageable pageable)'. Then update the implementation class accordingly to extract page and size from the Pageable object.
